_about: Answer key for demo/real-libraries.csv (phase 4c). Written by Isogeny Labs, not by the build; the build must never edit it. Adam to review. The 'expected' answers come from public sources (advisories, release notes, official test sets). Exact counts of wrong cases are listed separately under 'regression': they come from the build's own trial runs, so they are a consistency check, not independent proof. Rule for 'no' (Kevin's decision 1): an error raised by the library counts as 'not accepted'; a general crash is shown as an 'Also noticed' note, never as a result.

sources.CVE-2022-21449: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2022-21449 (Java 15 to 18 accept a blank ECDSA signature; fixed in 17.0.3, April 2022)
sources.CVE-2019-14859: https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-8qxj-f9rh-9fg2 (python-ecdsa accepts malformed signature encodings; fixed in 0.13.3)
sources.CVE-2019-14853: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2019-14853 (python-ecdsa crashes on malformed signatures; fixed in 0.13.3)
sources.CVE-2024-42460: https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-977x-g7h5-7qgw (elliptic: missing check on the leading bit of r and s; fixed in 6.5.7)
sources.wycheproof: C2SP/wycheproof commit 65ca494, ecdsa_secp256r1_sha256 file (484 cases) and the mlkem_768 / mldsa_65 files
sources.acvp: usnistgov/ACVP-Server commit 975de31, ML-KEM FIPS 203 and ML-DSA FIPS 204 files
